personaggio_001.descrizione: A Hearts warrior with a fiery temper, always ready to strike first.

personaggio_002.descrizione: Rules the Hearts suit with a fire that never goes out, not even in defeat.

personaggio_003.descrizione: Guards the treasures of Diamonds behind a transparent, unbreakable armor.

personaggio_004.descrizione: Their throne is carved from amber: every move is calculated and precious.

personaggio_005.descrizione: A silent protector of Clubs, rooted and patient.

personaggio_006.descrizione: The rarest form of the Clubs suit: said to be as old as the deck itself.

personaggio_007.descrizione: Moves through Spades without a sound, striking before being seen.

personaggio_008.descrizione: The deadliest of the Spades characters: no one sees them coming twice.

sorpresa_001.descrizione: A direct damage strike, playable at any point in the match.

sorpresa_002.descrizione: Temporarily boosts your character's ATT: two turns of pure aggression.

trappola_001.descrizione: Stays hidden until the opponent draws: then forces them to discard.

trappola_002.descrizione: If you take damage while active, half of it is returned to the attacker.

sorpresa_003.descrizione: One gesture, three gifts: it strikes the opponent, heals one of your heroes and grants you an extra card on your next draw.

trappola_003.descrizione: Can only be deployed when your heroes are down to less than half. If the opponent dares use an ability, it blocks their melding for a turn.
